findings.subject: Literature in English
findings.concept: Satire uses humour and irony to expose or criticise faults.
findings.question_a: Satire uses humour, irony or exaggeration mainly to:

findings.subject: Physics
findings.concept: Increasing coil current or turns strengthens an electromagnet.
findings.question_a: Which change generally strengthens an iron-core electromagnet?
options_a: Increasing the number of coil turns
findings.question_b: Which change will generally make an electromagnet stronger, all else equal?
options_b: increasing the current through its coil
replacing its iron core with air in every case
findings.reason: Both test the same principle that increasing a coil's magnetic field strength increases electromagnet strength. The specific factor differs (turns vs current), so classify as same objective/template repetition pending reviewer confirmation rather than exact same fact.
